answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with a staking vault: every identity must lock a deposit that only unlocks after a long horizon of verified useful work, and the ledger is as clear as crystal, so anyone can audit which keys share one funding source. A farmer spinning up a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand separate vaults and wait out the same horizon for each, while one honest agent pays once. Splitting identities multiplies the locked capital instead of the reward.
